title: Three Months and One Short Stamp
subtitle: 战争和平 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 战争和平（历史社会与文化·战争与和平）
meta: 主题语境：战争和平（历史社会与文化·战争与和平）　|　核心词汇：movement　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 movement 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1995 the clerk ① led the movement that no applicant in the office would have noted, and he said the leading was the whole of the month. The ② movement, meaning the march itself and not the stamp, ran three months and stayed unnoted in the book; a movement, he said, is the only thing in an office that is judged by how long it is left unnoted.

Every ③ movement in that office had the same short stamp beside it, and the ④ movement at the far counter, meaning the form they kept for the children to sign and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A movement, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to note; the clerk said the noting is the part that fills three months.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the movement was the whole of the matter, meaning the change and not the march. The ⑥ movement, meaning the change and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody notes; movement, he said, is either something you lead or the only word that means both a march and a change. He said the change is the part they remember.

By 2000 the ⑦ movement had become a line in a file, and the file had become an argument about the short stamp. The ⑧ movement of the whole thing, the clerk wrote in May, was one office and three months of noting; movement, he said, is either the form at the far counter or the reason you learned to note. He said the noting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ movement I remember is the march noted in the file, which closed in 2002 and is still noted as the quietest in the office. A ⑩ movement, my mother said in 2004, is the only march that improves by being noted; every movement, she said, is a change that has agreed to look like a march. She said the change was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 运动；活动（指办事处里每一场旁边的那一场）
B. n. 运动；活动（指那场运动本身，与小小的印章相对）
C. 固定搭配：lead the movement 领导这一场运动
D. n. 运动；活动（指留给孩子们签的那一份）
E. n. 运动之事（抽象总称，指一处办事处的运动之事）
F. n. 运动；活动（指卷宗里写到、被记下的那一场）
G. n. 运动、变迁（指一件事里人人都办却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 变迁（抽象总称，指人人都办却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: led the movement that no applicant in the office would have noted
The movement, meaning the march itself and not the stamp
the movement at the far counter
the movement was the whole of the matter
the movement had become a line in a file
The movement of the whole thing
A movement, my mother said in 2004

answers.why: lead the movement 意为“领导这一场运动”，1995 年那位书记员把办事处里没有一位申请人肯记下的一场运动做了一遍。
movement 意为“运动；活动”，指那场运动本身而不是小小的印章，它经过了三个月份而在簿子上没有被记下。
movement 意为“运动；活动”，指办事处里每一场旁边的那一场，每一场旁边都有同一枚小小的印章。
movement 意为“运动；活动”，指最远那个窗口的留给孩子们签的那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
movement 意为“运动、变迁”，指一件事里人人都办却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这场变迁就是那件事的全部。
movement 意为“变迁”，指人人都办却无人提起的那样东西而不是那场运动，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
movement 意为“运动；活动”，指卷宗里写到、被记下的那一场，到 2000 年这一场成了卷宗里的一行。
movement 意为“运动之事”，书记员五月写道，整件事的运动之事是一处办事处和三个月份的记下。
movement 意为“运动；活动”，我记得的是卷宗里记下过的那一场，2002 年办结了，至今仍被说成办事处里最安静的一场。
movement 为抽象总称，母亲 2004 年说，运动是唯一会因为被好好记下而变得更好的运动。
